query: Set up a new agent wallet from scratch for my Ethereum trading bot
expected_behavior: Uses the parent organization as the default path
Creates a wallet using POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet
Creates a non-root agent user using POST /public/v1/submit/create_users
Collects wallet, destination, spending, and contract/function constraints before policy creation
Creates a narrowly scoped signing policy instead of a canned persona bundle
Verifies the setup with a test signature
Outputs the agent credentials (public key, private key, org ID, wallet address)

query: Rotate the API key for my existing agent on Turnkey
expected_behavior: Generates a new P-256 key pair locally
Registers the new public key via POST /public/v1/submit/create_api_keys
Verifies the new key works with POST /public/v1/query/whoami
Deletes the old key via POST /public/v1/submit/delete_api_keys using the new key
Instructs the admin to update the agent's runtime environment

query: Revoke all access for my agent immediately
expected_behavior: Deletes the agent's API keys via POST /public/v1/submit/delete_api_keys as the first step
Explains that API key deletion is instant and the agent can no longer authenticate
Suggests optional cleanup: delete policies or delete the agent user

query: My agent's transaction got denied. How do I figure out which policy blocked it?
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/query/get_policy_evaluations with the denied activity ID
Explains the evaluation trace showing which policy denied and which condition matched
Suggests fixing the policy or adjusting the agent's transaction parameters

query: Add Solana support to my existing agent's wallet on Turnkey
expected_behavior: Uses POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet_accounts to derive a Solana account on the existing wallet
Uses CURVE_ED25519, PATH_FORMAT_BIP32, path m/44'/501'/0'/0', ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA
Mentions that existing EVM policies will not apply to Solana and new chain-specific policies may be needed

query: I want to set up an agent but it only needs read-only access, no signing
expected_behavior: Explains the read-only access scope from the decision gates
Creates the agent user but does NOT create an ALLOW signing policy
Explains that all users can read data in their own organization by default (implicit read permission)
Only adds an observer-specific DENY if the broader org policy set makes it necessary
